Add currency support to this billing code. money.Money gains a Currency field, an ISO code such as "EUR". money.Format writes the code before the amount: Format(Money{Cents: 1050, Currency: "EUR"}) is "EUR 10.50". money.Sum becomes func Sum(ms ...Money) (Money, error): it returns money.ErrMixedCurrency when its amounts are in different currencies, and the shared currency on the total otherwise (the zero Money for no amounts). invoice.Total carries the currency through and returns any error; report.Render prints the currency codes and returns any error. Update every caller and every test.
